   - Bacterium: Bacteria are microscopic living things with an encapsulated nucleus containing the DNA for the cell. They belong to the bacteria class from the realm, kingdom Prokaryota,  the second most primitive group out of all organisms next to archaeans.

2. Size. - Generally, the size of a microscopic virus ranges in size from 20 nm to a few hundred.
